citation: Culliney, M., Moore, N., Coldwell, M., & Demack, S. (2019). Integrating English: Evaluation report. London: Education Endowment Foundation. (Independent evaluators: Sheffield Institute of Education, Sheffield Hallam University.)
report_number: EEF project: Integrating English (LiLAC genre pedagogy), September 2019
design: School-level two-armed cluster RCT (efficacy trial), business-as-usual control. 91 primary schools recruited / 90 with secondary data; randomised 46 intervention (2483 pupils) vs 45 control (2279 pupils); 80 schools in the primary-outcome analysis (39 int + 41 ctrl). KS2 cohort taught Integrating English (LiLAC genre pedagogy CPD) across Year 5 (2016/17) and Year 6 (2017/18). Subjects/outcomes: KS2 Writing (primary, past-paper test), KS2 Reading and KS2 GPS (Grammar/Punctuation/Spelling) (secondary, from National Pupil Database). Trial Oct 2016-Jul 2018. Programme developed/delivered by Enfield LA School Improvement Team; funded by EEF, Unbound Philanthropy, The Bell Foundation.
problems: Single TPD arm (LiLAC/Integrating English) vs business-as-usual control, mapped to registry row_id 21. The report's headline effect sizes (Table 8 ITT; Appendix E, p.64-65) are explicitly labelled Hedges' g and are computed correctly per the spec: g = (T-C)_adjusted / sqrt(school_var + pupil_var), where the numerator is the intervention dummy coefficient from the FULL multilevel model (pupils nested in schools; pretest/covariate-adjusted) and the standardising SD is the TOTAL SD from the null/empty (stage-0) model (Writing: sqrt(37.17)=6.096). These are therefore both pretest_adjusted=true and cluster_adjusted=true (multilevel SEs already account for clustering). n_clusters set to 80 (schools in the primary-outcome ITT model); note the secondary outcomes (Reading, GPS) had lower attrition and ran on essentially all 80/90 schools. ICC = 0.18 (overall analysis-stage school-level ICC, Table 6, p.24; null-model ICC for writing = 0.17 in Table E1). impact_estimate fields hold the report's Hedges' g (the report does not separately tabulate the model coefficient for Reading/GPS, only their g and CIs in Table 8; for Writing the full-model coefficient = -0.29 with SE 0.518 on the raw KS2-writing mark scale, given in Table E1). impact_se left null where only the g-scale CI is available; g_se/g_var below are derived from the report's 95% CIs (g_se = (CI_hi - CI_lo)/(2*1.96)); for Writing this (0.0842) matches coef-SE/6.096 = 0.085, confirming the CIs are the model-based cluster-adjusted intervals. Raw posttest means/SDs available only for KS2 Writing (Table D1, p.61): Int 15.72 (SD 5.916), Ctrl 15.79 (SD 6.187); for Reading and GPS only raw means + their CIs are given in Table 8 (no SDs), so sd_t/sd_c left null for those. J small-sample correction ~1.000 (df very large, thousands of pupils). EAL and FSM rows are pre-specified subgroups (Tables 9 and 11): is_full_sample=false, outcome_role=subgroup. The intervention targets writing/English language (genre pedagogy, LiLAC); per spec subject mapping: writing/language/grammar -> Other, reading/literacy -> Reading. No STEM outcomes reported. All effects are small and statistically non-significant (favouring control slightly).

effect_sizes.test_name: KS2 Writing (past-paper test, 2012 KS2 test paper; max 31 marks)
effect_sizes.timepoint: post (summer 2018, end of Year 6 / end of trial)
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's Hedges g (Table 8 / Appendix E): g = (T-C)_adjusted / sqrt(school_var+pupil_var) = full-model intervention coefficient (-0.29, SE 0.518 on raw mark scale) / total null-model SD (sqrt(37.17)=6.096) = -0.29/6.096 = -0.048 ~ -0.05. Pretest- and covariate-adjusted multilevel model (pupils nested in schools). g_se/g_var derived from reported 95% CI (-0.21, +0.12): g_se=(0.12-(-0.21))/(2*1.96)=0.0842; matches coefSE/6.096=0.085.

effect_sizes.notes: PRIMARY confirmatory outcome. Writing -> Other (language/writing). ~ -1 month progress, p=0.577, EEF security 3/5 padlocks. Multilevel model fully accounts for school clustering.
